content.title: Diljit Dosanjh Recites Couplet at Indore Concert Amid Security Concerns
content.caption: Singer Diljit Dosanjh recites a couplet by Rahat Indori at his concert in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, amidst security concerns and objections.

slides.heading: Security Concerns and Objections

slides.heading: Diljit Dosanjh's Recitation
slides.text: Diljit Dosanjh recites the couplet 'Kisi ke baap ka Hindostan thodi hai' by Rahat Indori at his Indore concert.
